name: How much does foreclosed property interior repair cost, and what drives the price?

mainEntity.name: How much does foreclosed property interior repair cost, and what drives the price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the amount of interior damage, cleanup volume, materials needed, and whether hidden issues are found after the property is opened up. A detailed walkthrough is the best way to avoid underbidding, because foreclosed homes often reveal extra work once walls, floors, or cabinets are exposed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price is driven by damage level, cleanup volume, materials, and hidden issues found during inspection. A walkthrough is the most reliable way to get an accurate estimate.
